messages.subject: Interactive R Dashboards for Data Visualization
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Learn to create dynamic data visualizations and dashboards to effectively communicate your research. Interactive Data Visualization and Dashboards with R led by Dave Armstrong (Centre for Computational and Quantitative Social Science, University of Western Ontario) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar teaches how to create powerful interactive data visualizations and dashboards using R. Researchers using lavaan can apply these skills to present their complex latent variable models and statistical results more effectively. Learning to build interactive displays will enhance engagement with your research and facilitate clearer communication of findings.

Access this seminar whenever convenient and feel free to circulate this with colleagues and students who may be interested!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
